reason: A DeepSeek Harness tool that orchestrates authorized garak baseline red-team scans against configured LLM REST endpoints and produces auditable findings and evidence reports.

summaries.zh: 通过授权门禁和预算限制调用 garak 对配置的 LLM REST 端点执行基线安全扫描，并生成可审计的证据报告。
summaries.en: Runs budget-limited, authorization-gated garak baseline security scans against configured LLM REST endpoints and generates auditable evidence reports.

capabilities: Runs the external garak CLI process
Sends configured probe requests to a target LLM REST endpoint
Parses scan output and calculates per-probe metrics
Writes Markdown evidence reports and raw-report references
Records scan results in the DeepSeek Harness session log
